covenants.detail: Minimum consolidated Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 1.30x, tested quarterly on a trailing twelve month basis across both properties and the management company.
covenants.clause: Section 7.01(a) of the Master Credit Agreement: Borrower shall maintain a Debt Service Coverage Ratio of not less than 1.30 to 1.00.
covenants.notes: Coverage is net operating income after a 4 percent FF&E reserve and the management fee, divided by scheduled principal and interest on all mortgage and term debt. The FF&E reserve deduction is what keeps this ratio tight relative to reported hotel EBITDA.

evaluations.comments: Q3 2025 test at 1.41x on a trailing twelve month basis, compliant.
Q4 2025 test at 1.38x, compliant. Lakeside out of service rooms during the property improvement plan cost roughly 0.05x.
Q2 2026 test at 1.34x. Compliant but trending down on softer transient rate in the resort submarket.

covenants.detail: Maximum loan to value of 70 percent on each mortgaged property, measured as the first mortgage balance over the most recent lender-approved appraised value, tested annually and on receipt of any new appraisal.
covenants.clause: Section 7.01(b) of the Master Credit Agreement: the outstanding principal of each Property Loan shall not exceed 70 percent of the Appraised Value of the Property securing it.
covenants.notes: IN BREACH. The August 2026 lender-ordered update on the Lakeside property came in at $23.5MM against $26.0MM at origination, putting that loan at 72.1 percent against the 70 percent maximum. The Airport property tests at 63.1 percent on the February 2026 appraisal and is inside the covenant. A paydown or a partial recourse cure has been requested and is not yet agreed, so the exception is carried Unmitigated.

evaluations.comments: 2024 annual test on the origination appraisals. Lakeside 68.4 percent, Airport 69.2 percent, both compliant.
2025 annual test. Lakeside 66.9 percent on the origination appraisal, Airport 66.1 percent, both compliant.

Out of cycle test on the August 2026 Lakeside reappraisal. $16.94MM against $23.5MM is 72.1 percent, 2.1 points above the covenant maximum. Reported to the credit officer 21 August 2026; see policy exception CRE-LTV-01.

covenants.detail: Minimum debt yield of 9.00 percent, being trailing twelve month net operating income after the FF&E reserve divided by the aggregate outstanding mortgage and term debt secured by the two properties, tested quarterly.
covenants.clause: Section 7.01(c) of the Master Credit Agreement.
covenants.notes: Debt yield is the test that keeps working when appraised values move, which is why it sits alongside the loan to value covenant. At 10.4 percent it carries 1.4 points of headroom even with the Lakeside value reduction, and it is the ratio the credit officer is leaning on while the loan to value exception is open.

evaluations.comments: Q4 2025 debt yield of 10.9 percent, compliant.
Q2 2026 debt yield of 10.4 percent, compliant.

covenants.detail: Monthly STR report and operating statement for each property within 30 days of month end, with a minimum blended revenue per available room of $118.00 across the two hotels.
covenants.clause: Section 6.03 of the Master Credit Agreement (Reporting) and Schedule 6.03 (Minimum RevPAR).
covenants.notes: Blended RevPAR is weighted by keys, 268 at Lakeside and 218 at the Airport property. July 2026 came in at $126.40 blended, $141.20 at Lakeside and $108.20 at the Airport hotel. The report is the covenant; the minimum is the trigger for a cash management sweep, not for a default.

evaluations.comments: June 2026 STR report. Blended RevPAR of $131.80, peak season.
July 2026 STR report. Blended RevPAR of $126.40, compliant.

reviews.narrative: FY2026 annual credit review of the Sunbelt Hospitality relationship, completed 28 August 2026 immediately after the Lakeside reappraisal. WATCH NOTE: the relationship is placed on the watch list at grade 6. The 14 August 2026 update appraisal on the Lakeside resort came in at $23.5MM against $26.0MM at origination, putting the $18.0MM first mortgage at 72.1 percent loan to value against a 70 percent covenant. Cash flow is unaffected and every payment is current, but the exception is carried Unmitigated pending either a paydown to $16.45MM or an agreed partial recourse cure from the sponsor. Relationship manager to report monthly to the credit officer until the exception is cleared.
reviews.summary: Sunbelt Hospitality Group: $38.5MM committed across six booked facilities in three packages, $34.667MM outstanding. Two Orlando hotels totalling 486 keys held in single purpose entities, both managed by the parent. Security is first mortgages and assignments of rents on both properties, first liens on the furniture, fixtures and equipment at each, a blanket lien on the management fee receivables and certificate of title liens on the shuttle fleet. Guarantees from Sunbelt Hospitality Group Inc and from Marcus Delgado, both unlimited and full recourse. Halcyon Capital Partners at 30 percent provides no guaranty.
reviews.recommendation: Hold the grade at 6 and place the relationship on the watch list. Do not waive the loan to value covenant. Require either a $490K principal curtailment on the Lakeside first mortgage or a partial recourse cure agreement from Marcus Delgado within 90 days, and a second update appraisal at 30 June 2027. Continue the $2.0MM corporate revolver on existing terms; it renews November 2027.
reviews.riskComments: Grade affirmed at 6 with a watch note. Debt service coverage of 1.34x and debt yield of 10.4 percent are both inside covenant and both trending down about 0.02x and 0.5 points per quarter on softer transient rate in the resort submarket. The loan to value breach is a valuation event, not a cash flow event: no payment has ever been late on any of the six facilities. The Airport property is the stronger of the two at 63.1 percent loan to value and a full year of the airline crew contract.
reviews.strengths: Seventeen years of single ownership and management under Marcus Delgado, who guarantees every facility without limit. Both properties are franchised under long dated licences with the property improvement plan at Lakeside completed in October 2025 and the Airport plan not due until 2029. Blended RevPAR of $126.40 is 7 percent above the covenant minimum and ahead of the comp set. Airport property appraised UP in February 2026.
reviews.weaknesses: Single market concentration: both hotels are in Orlando and both depend on the same leisure and airport demand drivers. Capitalisation rate expansion has removed $2.5MM of value at Lakeside and put the loan into covenant breach. Halcyon Capital Partners at 30 percent contributes no credit support and has no obligation to fund a cure. The management company is thinly capitalised on its own and the corporate revolver is secured mainly by intercompany receivables.

riskRatingReviews.comments: Annual risk rating review supporting the FY2026 annual review. Computed grade 6, affirmed with a watch note. The collateral valuation shortfall at Lakeside is reflected in the grade; no override requested. Guarantor financial statement dated 30 June 2026 shows liquidity of $4.1MM outside the business.
